use generated_dmn::{Value, evaluate};
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

const NS: &str = "urn:rust-proof:expressions";
const BOOLS: [Option<bool>; 3] = [Some(false), Some(true), None];
const AND: [[Option<bool>; 3]; 3] = [
    [Some(false), Some(false), Some(false)],
    [Some(false), Some(true), None],
    [Some(false), None, None],
];
const OR: [[Option<bool>; 3]; 3] = [
    [Some(false), Some(true), None],
    [Some(true), Some(true), Some(true)],
    [None, Some(true), None],
];

fn boolean(value: Option<bool>) -> Value {
    value.map_or(Value::Null, Value::Boolean)
}

fn number(coefficient: &str, scale: i32) -> Value {
    Value::Number {
        coefficient: coefficient.into(),
        scale,
    }
}

#[test]
fn matches_java_for_exact_comparison_nulls_and_unicode() {
    let a = number("12345678901234567890100", 3);
    let b = number("1234567890123456789010", 2);
    let mut inputs = BTreeMap::from([
        ((NS, "a"), a.clone()),
        ((NS, "b"), b.clone()),
        ((NS, "left"), Value::Text("😀".into())),
        ((NS, "right"), Value::Text("\u{e000}".into())),
    ]);
    for (left, flag) in BOOLS.into_iter().enumerate() {
        for (right, other) in BOOLS.into_iter().enumerate() {
            inputs.insert((NS, "flag"), boolean(flag));
            inputs.insert((NS, "other"), boolean(other));
            let actual = evaluate(&inputs).unwrap();
            let expected = BTreeMap::from([
                ((NS, "both"), boolean(AND[left][right])),
                ((NS, "either"), boolean(OR[left][right])),
                ((NS, "opposite"), boolean(flag.map(|value| !value))),
                (
                    (NS, "selected"),
                    if flag == Some(true) {
                        a.clone()
                    } else {
                        b.clone()
                    },
                ),
                (
                    (NS, "mixed"),
                    if flag.is_none() {
                        Value::Boolean(false)
                    } else {
                        Value::Null
                    },
                ),
                ((NS, "equal"), Value::Boolean(true)),
                ((NS, "different"), Value::Boolean(false)),
                ((NS, "less"), Value::Boolean(false)),
                ((NS, "less-equal"), Value::Boolean(true)),
                ((NS, "greater"), Value::Boolean(false)),
                ((NS, "greater-equal"), Value::Boolean(true)),
                ((NS, "negated"), number("-12345678901234567890100", 3)),
                ((NS, "positive"), a.clone()),
                ((NS, "text-less"), Value::Boolean(true)),
            ]);
            assert_eq!(actual, expected);
        }
    }
    inputs.insert((NS, "a"), Value::Null);
    inputs.insert((NS, "b"), Value::Null);
    let nulls = evaluate(&inputs).unwrap();
    for id in ["less", "negated", "positive", "selected"] {
        assert_eq!(nulls[&(NS, id)], Value::Null);
    }
    for id in ["equal", "mixed"] {
        assert_eq!(nulls[&(NS, id)], Value::Boolean(true));
    }
    inputs.insert((NS, "a"), number("-1000", 0));
    inputs.insert((NS, "b"), number("-9999", 1));
    let negatives = evaluate(&inputs).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(negatives[&(NS, "less")], Value::Boolean(true));
    assert_eq!(negatives[&(NS, "different")], Value::Boolean(true));
    assert_eq!(negatives[&(NS, "greater-equal")], Value::Boolean(false));
    inputs.insert((NS, "a"), number("1", -4096));
    inputs.insert((NS, "b"), number("0", 4096));
    let extreme = evaluate(&inputs).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(extreme[&(NS, "greater")], Value::Boolean(true));
    inputs.insert((NS, "a"), number("0", -4096));
    let zero = evaluate(&inputs).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(zero[&(NS, "equal")], Value::Boolean(true));
    assert_eq!(zero[&(NS, "negated")], number("0", -4096));
}
